name: Dropbox Storage Destination
author: McSparrow <hi@mcsparrow.dev>
description: Back up containers to Dropbox via the Dropbox HTTP API. Auth: a long-lived access token from a Dropbox app (https://www.dropbox.com/developers/apps). Chunked uploads use /2/files/upload_session with 8 MiB parts; small files take the simpler /2/files/upload endpoint. Same Test round-trip shape as the built-in local destination (credentials / write / change / delete).
